streamdeck.isConnected.description: Checks whether the Cuebot plugin in the Stream Deck app is connected right now.
streamdeck.isConnected.returns: true while at least one Stream Deck plugin is connected, otherwise false.

streamdeck.getInstances.description: Lists the Stream Deck apps that are connected to Cuebot, with their devices and Cuebot keys.
streamdeck.getInstances.returns: A list of apps. Each has id, remote, pluginVersion, streamDeckVersion, platform, connectedAt, devices (name, type, size) and buttons (buttonId, row, column, state and more).

streamdeck.setTitle.description: Changes the text shown on a Stream Deck key.

parameters.buttonId: The button id you gave the key in the Cuebot Stream Deck plugin, like "deaths". Needed.
parameters.title: The text to show, like "Deaths: 3".
parameters.state: Optional. Which state of a two-state key to change: 0 or 1. Leave it out for the state it shows now.

streamdeck.setTitle.returns: How many keys have this button id (0 when none was found).

streamdeck.setState.description: Switches a two-state Stream Deck key to state 0 or 1.

parameters.buttonId: The button id you gave the key in the Cuebot Stream Deck plugin. Needed.

streamdeck.setState.returns: How many keys have this button id (0 when none was found).

streamdeck.setBackground.description: Changes the picture on a Stream Deck key. Leave the image empty to put the normal picture back.

parameters.buttonId: The button id you gave the key in the Cuebot Stream Deck plugin. Needed.
parameters.image: A picture file on your computer, a web link (http or https) or a data: link. Empty puts the normal picture back.
parameters.state: Optional. Which state of a two-state key to change: 0 or 1. Leave it out for the state it shows now.

streamdeck.setBackground.returns: How many keys have this button id (0 when none was found).

streamdeck.setValue.description: Changes the value shown on a Stream Deck key or dial (Stream Deck +).

parameters.buttonId: The button id you gave the key or dial in the Cuebot Stream Deck plugin. Needed.
parameters.indicator: Optional. For dials: how full the bar is, 0-100.

streamdeck.setValue.returns: How many keys have this button id (0 when none was found).

streamdeck.showAlert.description: Flashes the warning sign on a Stream Deck key for a moment.

parameters.buttonId: The button id you gave the key in the Cuebot Stream Deck plugin. Needed.

streamdeck.showAlert.returns: How many keys have this button id (0 when none was found).

streamdeck.showOk.description: Flashes the check mark on a Stream Deck key for a moment.

parameters.buttonId: The button id you gave the key in the Cuebot Stream Deck plugin. Needed.

streamdeck.showOk.returns: How many keys have this button id (0 when none was found).

streamdeck.toggleState.description: Flips a two-state Stream Deck key to its other state.

parameters.buttonId: The button id you gave the key in the Cuebot Stream Deck plugin. Needed.

streamdeck.toggleState.returns: How many keys have this button id (0 when none was found).
